implementation: One selection/refresh job on existing display metadata lock and worker. Request/status have no I/O; pending cancel immediate, preparing cancellation waits for cleanup, committing/rendering noncancelable. Persistent revision checked in actual store. Save and render confirmations separate; successful save supersedes older trial. Release failure pins UNKNOWN and prevents volume reopening.

first_attempt.explanation: New native interface/include absent before implementation; compiler failure not business Red.

new_red_green.failure: New job refused further requests after unmount failure, but ordinary volume_open still returned0 on the mounted volume.
new_red_green.fix: Existing volume_open checks the same latched selection release-error before reuse; real test now requires EBUSY until explicit cleanup.
new_red_green.not_claimed: Not a detected injected mutant, HardFault root cause or physical shutdown fix.

integration.production: Real selection request/step, existing intent/trial/render identity, verbatim renderer/cache/volume functions, checked store/parser and unique volume arbiter.
integration.external: Virtual clock, mount/umount, fsync failure, framebuffer sinks; callbacks at mount/write verify cancel timing without substituting the state machine.
integration.oracle: Pending/prepare cancel leaves default and files unchanged; commit-cancel EBUSY; final actual pixels0x07e0; old trial cannot overwrite new default. Saved-but-render-failed retains version2; directory failure yields UNKNOWN and explicit refresh reads visiblev2 without claiming durability; release failure keeps busy and denies reopen.
integration.limits: Host invokes the production worker step directly, not the full RTOS thread scheduler. API/wire/TLS/PC auth binding still pending; no physical screen or FAT power-loss proof.

validation.AP: PASS final incremental build; worker step and checked store writer linked. New public request/status APIs still have no remote caller and are not linked.

style.includes: nxstyle skips .inc extensions. C projections of both new includes were checked; only deliberate projection/header path mismatch remains. Do not treat the direct .inc exit0 as a style pass.
style.limit: Existing C/header diagnostics remain; no whole-file style PASS.

resources.local_declarations: 80-byte copied request plus48-byte version and scalar locals; not measured stack high-water. Existing renderer/storage call stack remains.
resources.threads: No new thread/queue/heap. Existing display loop polls the single job and briefly reads the same metadata spinlock.
resources.blocking: Volume/commit/render occurs only on display owner outside metadata lock; request/status/cancel paths do not perform I/O. Kernel I/O completion bounds and hardware responsiveness remain unmeasured.
resources.not_measured: CPU avg/p95, actual stack/peak memory, DMA/ISR interference, voice/USB contention and SD durability.

RES-02.interface: Native async job+worker implemented; authenticated remote protocol, explicit release-recovery operation and client/UI not yet connected.
RES-02.L1_L2: 11 job/real-store-render cases pass, real release-reopen Red fixed. Original2 mutations preserved.
RES-02.L3: NOT_RUN; no phone or board operation.

remaining: Before exposing remote selection, add explicit release recovery; test fixture direct volume_close cleanup is not a product recovery interface.
